info.name: Payment Service
info.description:
Vubon.com.bd — Payment Service REST API

Base URL: http://localhost:3006
Swagger: http://localhost:3006/api/docs

## Auth
Collection uses Bearer token by default. Health + webhooks are public. Set {{accessToken}} env var.

## Idempotency
Payment + Refund creation require Idempotency-Key header (auto-set via {{uniqueSuffix}}).

## Flows
1. Initiate Payment → paymentId auto-saved
2. Confirm / Verify / Cancel / Retry payment
3. Request Refund → refundId auto-saved
4. Approve / Reject refund
